answer: Make honest work an oasis that only real effort can reach: a new identity starts at its nadir, with no standing and no credit, and must earn its way up through small, publicly graded jobs. Each identity is an island, unable to borrow another's history, so a fake must build its own record from scratch. If many new identities appear together with identical patterns, peers can hold them back until each proves itself, making a Sybil flood slow, expensive, and easy to spot.
